entries.description: Code review of Document layer (BaseColor, Document, PageSize, Rectangle) via Gemini Pro with Sonnet cross-verification. Findings: Document.Close() resource leak when writer set but Open() never called; Rectangle lacks value equality; BaseColor naming convention (Red_, Green_, Blue_); EnsureOpen dead code path.

Fixed Document.Close() state consistency: _closed now always set to true. Reordered EnsureOpen() checks so _closed is checked before !_open (dead code fix). Declined Rectangle→record (too invasive for V&V), BaseColor naming (deliberate), thread safety (not applicable).

Test gap analysis and new tests added. RectangleTests: +4 (FourArgConstructor, CopyConstructor independence, ToString, ZeroDimensions). PageSizeTests: +5 (A3, A5, Tabloid, Executive, AllOriginAtZero). DocumentIntegrationTests: +4 (PageNumber tracking, Close-without-Open, Close idempotent, NewPage-after-Close). BaseColorTests: +5 (GetHashCode consistency, null equality, both-null equality, ToString, LightGray/DarkGray).

Code review of PDF primitives (PdfObject, PdfArray, PdfDictionary, PdfBoolean, PdfNull, PdfNumber, PdfName, PdfString, PdfLiteral) via Gemini Pro with Sonnet cross-verification. Critical findings: PdfNumber.FormatDouble can produce scientific notation (forbidden in PDF spec); PdfName.Type hides PdfObject.Type with 'new' keyword. Major findings: PdfString.OriginalBytes exposes internal array; PdfArray allows null elements; PdfString.WriteHex allocates per-byte; PdfNumber(string) stores raw content without normalization; PdfName.EncodeName corrupts non-ASCII chars. Minor: PdfNull redundant WriteTo; PdfBoolean/PdfNull constructors should be private.

Fixed 8 issues: (1) PdfNumber.FormatDouble uses fixed-point '0.######' instead of 'G' to avoid scientific notation (Critical); (2) PdfNumber(string) normalizes stored Bytes via FormatDouble; (3) PdfString.OriginalBytes returns clone to prevent mutation; (4) PdfArray Add/Insert/indexer reject null with ArgumentNullException; (5) PdfString.WriteHex uses byte lookup table instead of per-byte string allocation; (6) PdfNull: reuse NullBytes in constructor, remove redundant WriteTo override; (7) PdfName.EncodeName handles non-ASCII via UTF-8 byte encoding; (8) PdfBoolean/PdfNull constructors made private (singleton enforcement). Declined: PdfObject.Type rename (too invasive for V&V), ReadOnlySpan conversion (not needed).

Reviewed PdfObjectTests.cs (334 lines, 32 tests across 8 test classes). Existing coverage: basic WriteTo and Type checks for all types, PdfName equality, PdfArray construction, PdfDictionary put/get. Gaps identified: PdfNumber scientific notation/NaN/string constructor; PdfString CR/LF escaping, byte ctor, clone safety; PdfName non-ASCII encoding, hash escaping; PdfArray null rejection, Insert/RemoveAt; PdfLiteral byte ctor; PdfBoolean/PdfNull singleton and ToString; PdfDictionary typed ctor, Remove, Contains.

Created PdfPrimitiveTests.cs with 61 new tests across 8 test classes: PdfBooleanPrimitiveTests (6), PdfNullPrimitiveTests (3), PdfNumberPrimitiveTests (13), PdfNamePrimitiveTests (10), PdfStringPrimitiveTests (9), PdfLiteralPrimitiveTests (4), PdfArrayPrimitiveTests (9), PdfDictionaryPrimitiveTests (8). Coverage includes: scientific notation prevention, NaN/Infinity handling, PdfNumber(string) normalization, non-ASCII name encoding, CR/LF escaping, OriginalBytes clone safety, null rejection in PdfArray, singleton identity, typed constructors.

Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (2 rounds). Round 1: ISSUES FOUND — minor: FormatDouble '0.######' limits to 6 decimal places. Fixed to '0.##############' (14 places). Round 2: ISSUES FOUND — minor: PdfNumber(string) normalization truncates precision. Deferred: reverting normalization would re-introduce scientific notation bug; double precision already limits to ~15-17 significant digits. Session review saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Code review of 8 PDF structure files via ai-router (Gemini). Verifier identified 2 false positives (xref entry length, %%EOF newline). Real findings: PdfPages.Complete() mutation hazard, PdfCrossReferenceTable free entry allocation in loop.

Fixed 2 issues: (1) PdfPages.Complete() — added idempotency flag and guard against AddPage after Complete to prevent silent mutation. (2) PdfCrossReferenceTable — cached free entry byte arrays as static readonly fields to avoid repeated allocations in loop.

Test gap analysis: PdfIndirectObject (3 tests), PdfIndirectReference (3 tests), PdfBody (4 tests), PdfCrossReferenceTable (2 tests), PdfTrailer (2 tests) already exist in PdfStreamTests.cs/PdfObjectTests.cs. Missing: PdfPage (0 tests), PdfPages (0 tests), PdfCatalog (0 tests). Gaps: xref entry byte length, xref gap-fill, PdfPages idempotency/mutation guard, PdfBody initial state.

Created tests/DabblerPdf.Tests/Pdf/PdfStructureTests.cs with 21 new tests: PdfPageTests (4), PdfPagesTests (6 — including idempotency and mutation guard), PdfCatalogTests (2), PdfCrossReferenceTableAdditionalTests (3 — byte length, gap-fill, sorting), PdfBodyAdditionalTests (3), PdfTrailerAdditionalTests (2).

Code review of Text/Font layer (BaseFont, Type1Font, TrueTypeFont, BuiltinFonts, PdfEncodings) via Gemini Pro with Sonnet cross-verification. Critical: thread-unsafe font cache. Major: Symbol/ZapfDingbats encoding hardcoded as WinAnsi, sparse width arrays in BuiltinFonts, TrueType parser lacks bounds checking. Minor: redundant .TTF check, ComputeFlags comment errors, manual UTF-16 decoding.

Fixed 7 issues: (1) BaseFont._fontCache switched to ConcurrentDictionary with GetOrAdd for thread safety (Critical); (2) Type1Font.CreateFontDictionary omits /Encoding for Symbol and ZapfDingbats per PDF spec (Major); (3) Added missing width entries 161-191 for TimesBold, TimesItalic, TimesBoldItalic from AFM data (Major); (4) TtfReader: added bounds-checking CanRead guard to all read methods (Major); (5) Removed redundant .TTF check in IsTrueTypeFontFile (Minor); (6) Fixed ComputeFlags bit-value comments (Minor); (7) DecodeUtf16Be now uses Encoding.BigEndianUnicode (Suggestion). Declined: removing unused 'embedded' parameter (API-breaking for V&V), surrogate pair handling (WinAnsi fonts only handle 0-255), Mac Roman encoding (requires new dependency).

Reviewed BaseFontTests (12 tests) and TrueTypeFontTests (14 tests). Both have good coverage of core functionality. Missing: Type1Font (0 tests — font dictionary, width lookups, descriptor values), PdfEncodings (0 tests — WinAnsi↔Unicode mapping, special chars 128-159, boundary values), BuiltinFonts (0 tests — standard font metrics spot-checks, extended Latin completeness). Also need tests for new fixes: Symbol/ZapfDingbats encoding omission, TimesBold/TimesItalic/TimesBoldItalic 161-191 widths.

Created 3 new test files: Type1FontTests.cs (18 tests: construction, width lookups, descriptor scaling, font dictionary including Symbol/ZapfDingbats encoding omission), PdfEncodingsTests.cs (16 tests: ASCII/Latin identity, special 128-159 mapping, undefined bytes, boundary values, round-trip for all defined bytes), BuiltinFontsTests.cs (14 tests: standard font recognition, descriptor values, width spot-checks, Courier monospace, oblique width sharing, extended Latin 161-191 completeness for all fonts, 192-255 completeness).

(2) TrueType caching by PS name = valid suggestion, declined for V&V scope. (3) Redundant cmap bounds check = applied cleanup since CanRead guard handles it. Routed all 4 image source files (Image.cs, Jpeg.cs, PngImage.cs, PdfImage.cs) to Gemini for code review. Cross-provider verification identified 5 genuine issues and 3 false positives.

Fixed 5 issues: (1) Image.ScaleToFit now respects 'never up' constraint, (2) Jpeg adds segment length >= 2 validation, (3) PngImage throws on truncated chunks instead of silent break, (4) PngImage sub-byte stride calculation fixed with GetBitsPerPixel(), (5) PdfImage no longer creates redundant SoftMask when softMaskRef provided.
Identified missing coverage: no dedicated Jpeg tests, no tests for ScaleToFit 'never up' behavior, no PNG sub-byte depth tests, no truncated chunk error tests.

Created JpegTests.cs (22 tests: SOF variants, color spaces, marker navigation, padding, error handling, edge cases). Extended ImageTests.cs with ScaleToFit no-scale-up, PNG truncated chunk, 4-bit grayscale tests. Added CreateSubBytePng helper to ImageTestHelpers.
